title: Bear cub holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <g>
    <!-- ears -->
    <circle cx="30" cy="32" r="11" fill="#a9683c"/>
    <circle cx="70" cy="32" r="11" fill="#a9683c"/>
    <circle cx="30" cy="32" r="6" fill="#e08bb0"/>
    <circle cx="70" cy="32" r="6" fill="#e08bb0"/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="26" fill="#c47a44"/>
    <!-- muzzle -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="14" ry="11" fill="#f2cfa4"/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx="41" cy="44" r="3.6" fill="#3a2417"/>
    <circle cx="59" cy="44" r="3.6" fill="#3a2417"/>
    <circle cx="42.2" cy="42.8" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <circle cx="60.2" cy="42.8" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="3.8" ry="3" fill="#3a2417"/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d="M43 59 Q50 65 57 59" fill="none" stroke="#7a4a28" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="84" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#c47a44"/>
    <!-- belly -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="13" ry="12" fill="#f2cfa4"/>
    <!-- arms hugging heart -->
    <ellipse cx="30" cy="76" rx="8" ry="10" fill="#a9683c" transform="rotate(20 30 76)"/>
    <ellipse cx="70" cy="76" rx="8" ry="10" fill="#a9683c" transform="rotate(-20 70 76)"/>
    <!-- heart -->
    <path d="M50 90 C36 78 34 68 42 66 C47 65 50 70 50 70 C50 70 53 65 58 66 C66 68 64 78 50 90 Z" fill="#e64b6b"/>
    <path d="M44 70 C46 69 48 71 48 72" fill="none" stroke="#ff9db0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- paws on heart -->
    <circle cx="36" cy="72" r="4" fill="#a9683c"/>
    <circle cx="64" cy="72" r="4" fill="#a9683c"/>
  </g>
</svg>
